item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is helping her grandmother plant tulsi and mango saplings in their courtyard. She notices that their leaves are broad and flat. Her grandmother says this shape helps the leaves make food more efficiently.

Which statement best justifies why broad, flat leaves make photosynthesis more efficient?

options.A: A broad, flat shape gives a large surface to receive sunlight, so the green leaf can make more food at its main food-making site
options.B: A broad, flat shape makes the leaf heavier, so it can store more water for making food
options.C: A broad, flat shape helps the leaf take in more soil minerals directly from the air
options.D: A broad, flat shape stops sunlight from reaching the leaf, so the leaf does not dry out
